individual-data-points.explanation: Main graphs plot the actual measured intensity values at each time point as scatter data (red/green dots) overlaid with a fitted model curve, so individual measurements are directly shown rather than summarized.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The insets show averaged early time-point responses with vertical error bars, but the caption only states that insets represent averages without specifying what the error bars quantify (e.g., SD, SEM, or CI).
